description_en: Deletes a specified Server Message Block (SMB) user from a file gateway
description_zh: 删除文件网关中指定的SMB用户
kebab_example: aliyun sgw delete-gateway-smb-user --gateway-id gw-000c6hshwukkbrypj000 --username username --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteGatewaySMBUser

parameters.help_en: The SMB username. The username must be 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: SMB用户名。长度限制为1~32个字符，可以是英文、数字或符号短划线（-）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: username
